get.description: Returns local stored Responses from gateway cache; OpenAI Direct stored Responses with upstream lineage are synced from the original upstream Response first. If the local object is missing, model query or X-AI-Gateway-OpenAI-Model can explicitly route an unknown remote resp_ id to OpenAI Direct.

parameters.name: responseId
parameters.description: Stored Response id.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional OpenAI Responses fields to include. Local stored baseline accepts this parameter as a no-op; OpenAI Direct objects with upstream lineage or explicit route hints forward it upstream.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Gateway route hint for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

parameters.name: X-AI-Gateway-OpenAI-Model
parameters.description: Gateway route hint header for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

delete.description: Deletes local stored Responses; OpenAI Direct stored Responses with upstream lineage issue DELETE to the original upstream Response before marking the local object deleted. Unknown remote resp_ ids require an explicit model route hint.

parameters.name: responseId
parameters.description: Stored Response id.

parameters.description: Gateway route hint header for unknown remote OpenAI Direct resp_ ids that do not have local lineage.

post.description: Cancels local background Responses or forwards cancel to the original OpenAI Direct upstream Response when lineage is available. Unknown remote resp_ ids require an explicit model route hint.

get.description: Lists local input items or forwards the query to the original OpenAI Direct upstream Response when lineage is available. Unknown remote resp_ ids require an explicit model route hint.

parameters.description: Stored Response id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of input items to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by input item order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

get.description: Returns Batch objects created through this gateway for the current Distributed Key. It does not enumerate upstream organization history that was not created through the gateway.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Batch from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Batch objects to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

get.description: Lists public gateway model ids and aliases accessible to the current Distributed Key.
Retrieves model metadata from the gateway model catalog when the current Distributed Key may access it.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id or gateway fine-tuned model alias.

delete.description: Deletes only fine-tuned model registry entries created or imported through this gateway for the current Distributed Key. It does not delete public models or call upstream owner-role model deletion.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id or gateway fine-tuned model alias.

get.description: Returns local lifecycle events recorded by this gateway for the current Distributed Key's Fine-tuning job. It does not enumerate the upstream organization's full event history.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Gateway-tracked Fine-tuning job id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Fine-tuning event from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Fine-tuning event records to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

get.description: Returns local checkpoint evidence for the current Distributed Key's Fine-tuning job. If the gateway has no completed model or checkpoint evidence, data is empty.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Gateway-tracked Fine-tuning job id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Fine-tuning checkpoint from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Fine-tuning checkpoint records to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

post.summary: Create a local OpenAI Vector Store
post.description: Creates a gateway-local Vector Store lifecycle object. File ids are accepted as local references; local content read and local text search are available, while real vector ingestion is not implemented in this baseline.

metadata.description: OpenAI metadata object preserved by the gateway.

file_ids.description: Local file ids to associate as references. Local content read and local text search are available; real vector ingestion is not implemented in this baseline.

expires_after.description: OpenAI expires_after object, for example anchor=last_active_at and days=7.

get.description: Lists gateway-local Vector Stores for the current Distributed Key with OpenAI-compatible list envelope pagination.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Vector Store from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Vector Stores to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by creation time: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

post.summary: Search a local OpenAI Vector Store
post.description: Searches readable gateway-local vector_store.file attachments with a deterministic UTF-8 lexical baseline. This does not perform hosted OpenAI semantic vector ingestion or rerank.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

query.description: Search query string or string array. Local baseline accepts either shape.

filters.description: Attribute filter tree over vector_store.file attributes. Supports eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/in/nin and and/or.

max_num_results.description: Maximum local results to return. Defaults to 10; valid range is 1 to 50.

ranking_options.description: Local lexical score_threshold is honored; ranker is preserved as metadata only.

rewrite_query.description: Accepted as a compatibility no-op in the local lexical baseline.

post.summary: Attach a local OpenAI Vector Store File
post.description: Attaches a file id to a gateway-local Vector Store as a local vector_store.file reference. This does not perform real vector ingestion.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

file_id.description: File id to attach to the local Vector Store.

attributes.description: OpenAI Vector Store File attributes. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans or null.

chunking_strategy.description: OpenAI chunking strategy object. Defaults locally to auto.

get.summary: List local OpenAI Vector Store Files
get.description: Lists gateway-local Vector Store File attachments. Local file content read and deterministic local text search are available; real vector ingestion and semantic vector search are not implemented in this baseline.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor id of the last Vector Store File from the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of Vector Store Files to return. Defaults to 20; valid range is 1 to 100.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by creation time: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional local status filter such as completed or failed.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: fileId

get.summary: Retrieve local OpenAI Vector Store File content
get.description: Returns a gateway-local vector_store.file_content.page by reading the attached gateway file as a UTF-8 text page. This does not perform hosted OpenAI parsing, embedding or vector ingestion.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: File id attached to the local Vector Store.

post.summary: Create a local OpenAI Vector Store File Batch
post.description: Creates a gateway-local vector_store.file_batch and attaches multiple file ids after all duplicate checks pass. This does not perform real vector ingestion.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

file_ids.description: File ids to attach in one local batch. Provide either file_ids or files, not both.

files.description: Per-file batch entries. Each item requires file_id and may include attributes or chunking_strategy.

attributes.description: Attributes applied to every file when file_ids is used.

chunking_strategy.description: Chunking strategy applied to every file when file_ids is used.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store File Batch id.

post.description: Rejects cancel for gateway-local completed batches; future asynchronous ingestion may extend cancellable in-progress states.

parameters.name: vectorStoreId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store id.

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: Local Vector Store File Batch id.

post.description: Verifies Standard Webhooks headers against the raw request body and stores valid OpenAI events as gateway-local WEBHOOK_EVENT resources. Duplicate webhook deliveries or duplicate event ids return duplicate=true without another write.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: Unique Standard Webhooks delivery id. Duplicate delivery ids are accepted idempotently.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds timestamp used by the Standard Webhooks signature.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: Standard Webhooks signature header. Supports v1,base64 signatures and multiple space-separated candidates.

id.description: OpenAI webhook event id. Used as the local resource key when present.

type.description: OpenAI webhook event type such as response.completed.
